description.text: Program Description Applied economics is an applied social science discipline based on the theories of economics, finance, quantitative economics, statistics, etc. The professional mainly for major financial institutions, securities companies, financial regulators and large enterprise training needed, with strong professional knowledge and ability to apply advanced technology, high quality, internationalization theory research and operational practice of high-level talents.

duration.text: The Applied Economics at Beijing Jiaotong University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4722 USD/per year ￥ 34000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Master's Degree or an equivalen 2.Two recommendations by two professors or associate professors 3.Pass of relevant examinations
